text:
rhett: okay quick shout 1: our league just had a last-minute trade that affects the playoff tiebreaker. thoughts? :eyes:
anya: wait what trade?? spill.
kevin: link to trade: https://fantasy.league/trades/808 (not official until commish rubber-stamps)
mina: oh no not another flea-flicker move. ben traded his bench RB for a streaming QB?? that seems like chaos.
ben: not chaos, strategic chaos. he has a bye-proof plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
rhett: problem is this pushes ben and anya into a tie for 3rd with identical points and bench rules. we need a tiebreaker and our rulebook is vague.
anya: i nominate skill challenge. 10 pushups for the loser on monday standup. :muscle:
kevin: love the pushups but also if ben wins he has to wear the loser jersey next week. agreed?
mina: also can we do something less physical? recall last years tragic pushup snafu. maybe a poetry roast? :microphone:
ben: i'll take the poetry roast. i cannot risk a pulled muscle before the weekend.
rhett: community option: 1) Head-to-head last 2 weeks 2) Coinflip video 3) Slack judge vote. Vote with 1/2/3 within 30m and i'll enforce.
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Playoff tiebreaker method" ) Head-to-head (last 2 weeks) 2) Coinflip video 3) Slack majority vote. Vote with :one: :two: or :three:. Ends in 30m.
anya: head-to-head seems fairest. coinflip is fun but salty.
kevin: head-to-head wins from me. minimizes drama.
mina: slack vote is tempting because of memes. would anyone contest rigging? :grimacing:
ben: i'm secretly campaigning for coinflip so i can produce an overdramatic slow-mo flip. production value matters. :clapper:
rhett: reminder: trades are frozen pending commish review. if trade invalidates competitive integrity we reserve rollback.
anya: true. can the commish please review before we do anything performative?
kevin: @rhett you're the commish tonight, do your thing.
rhett: will review now. ETA 10m. if trade stands we'll go head-to-head. if not, nothing to decide. will post outcome here.
mina: thanks. also side bet: loser of any tiebreaker buys team lunch. just sayin'. :sandwich:
ben: i accept those terms. small price for slow-mo glory.
poll-bot: Update: Poll live 10m in: 9 votes, leaning to Head-to-head. Ends at 1976543410.
kevin: good. also reminder for everyone1: set lineups for sunday kickoff. no sympathy for late swaps.
rhett: trade approved. proceeding with Head-to-head. tallying results now. will DM final scoreboard + loser lunch order. chaos averted. :tada:
